conventions.axes: x east, y north (plan feet, origin arbitrary, SW of the house). Street is to the east.
conventions.floor: finished floor at z = 0 (= 10.91 ft NAVD88 per the survey). Rooms and surfaces not at 0 carry `floor_z` (feet relative to the main floor): Studio -8", Carport -4", Front porch -4".
conventions.wall: a->b line + thickness t. `footprint` is the resolved plan outline (4 corners, CCW-or-CW) with wall-end cuts already applied: extrude it. Exterior walls have `face` L|R = side of a->b that is the exterior face. `exterior_faces` [{face, from, to}] = a stretch of an interior wall that faces outside (W11 at the lanai). `covers` [{from, to, material}] = trim over the wall between mated windows, floor to head; with `sill` / `head` (and `ribbon`) = a panel (e.g. plywood) between windows inside one trimmed ribbon opening.
conventions.opening: along its wall, measured from a: center `at`, width `w`, so the gap is `from`..`to`. type: door | window | slider | opening (cased) | hole (plain gap). Doors: hinge a|b, swing L|R looking a->b, `leaves` 2 = French pair, `bifold`. `pocket` a|b = pocket door / slider parking toward that end of the wall (true = side not known). `pivot_pocket` = retractable cabinet-style doors: `leaves` panels split the opening, each hinged at its jamb, opening 90 deg and sliding back into a pocket along the side wall (the housings are casework elements). `sill` / `head` = feet above the floor of the room it serves (doors, windows, sliders; from William's rules unless set per opening). `sill_type` masonry = rowlock brick sill outside. `pattern` = glazing: rows / cols equal panels; sides = operable side sections (ft) with sideRows panels high and one fixed pane between; jalousie = blade spacing (ft); lite jalousie on a door; ribbon = windows cased as one band with trim posts between (windows sharing a ribbon name share one trim opening; the wall `covers` with that ribbon fill the gaps).
conventions.phase: existing = stays; new = new work. (Demolished items are already removed.)
conventions.elements: casework / fixtures / equipment / furniture as plan linework: `lines` = polylines [x1,y1,x2,y2,...]; `fills` = closed outlines of the solid parts (counters, booths, tables). kind upper = wall cabinets (12in deep, above the counter); beam = overhead beam line, `bottom` = underside height (ft). A3 is a 32in induction cooktop on the counter with a 30in oven below (`oven`). Optional: `back` (seat backrest side N|S|E|W), `z` [bottom, top] (wall-mounted items), `shelves` (heights of floating shelves, `thick` each), `height` (top above the floor), `color` (colour key, e.g. wood), `toe_kick` {h, recess} (ft; the refrigerator's grille, like the cabinets), `top` = countertop outline where it differs from the cabinet body in `fills` (same vertex order; the pass-through counter runs 4in past the cabinet back), `glass` on a shower {side N|S|E|W, door {w, end, hinge}, height} = glass on its open side with a hinged door at that end.
conventions.columns: posts: center `at`, w x d (ft), `angle` (deg) of the w side; material wood | brick | aluminum.
conventions.landscape: the revised site plan (model/site_rev.json in the floor-plan project), plan feet, flat on the ground unless noted. kind area (poly, holes, mat: concrete | deck | bed (mulch) | planting (dense foliage; `of` = its bed) | gravel | pebbles (shell) | turf | sod; `angle` = deck board direction, plan degrees CCW from east), circle (c, r, mat), rock (poly), plant (c, r, sym tree | palm | shrub; names with "keep" are existing), line (pts, st: fence = 4ft hogwire, wpc = 6ft privacy panel, gate, joint = slab joint, rail, dash = plan-only (gate swings, paths), future = future work outline). Named items: "... planter wall" = 8in retaining walls of raised planters ("Play zone curb" = 6in curb); "Tee-pee leg" = Bijou Builds pyramid legs, foot to apex (9.5ft); "Access lane centerline" = the 5ft vehicle-access lane; "Future pool" = 16x32 outline. It replaces the survey's fences and existing paving where they overlap.
conventions.construction: '2x4' wood frame (exterior 5.75in, interior 4.5in incl. finishes), '2x6' plumbing walls, 'brick' long cement brick (~16x8in, 3/4in joints), 'screen' lanai screen on 4x4 posts.
